GENE_FUNCTION: Nucleoside diphosphate-linked moiety X-type motif 15 (NUDIX hydrolase); dephosphorylates thiopurine active metabolites (thioguanine triphosphates), reducing their incorporation into DNA. NUDT15 deficiency → excess thioguanine nucleotide accumulation → myelosuppression.
